stories.headline: Trump not keen on wearing body armour as Secret Service says agent not shot by friendly fire
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has declined to wear body armour despite a recent incident where a Secret Service agent was shot. The agent's life was reportedly saved by a bulletproof vest. Trump was asked if he would wear a vest, but did not appear keen on the idea. This comes after an attack at a Saturday dinner location, where the suspect, Cole Tomas Allen, allegedly carried out the shooting. The Secret Service has defended the security protocols in place at the time, with an official stating the site was "set up perfectly." Trump has also stated that the agent was not shot by friendly fire, saying "they said it wasn't friendly fire. It wasn't us." The suspect has agreed to remain jailed while awaiting trial. The incident has raised questions about the President's security measures.

stories.headline: US prosecutors release video of armed man storming correspondents' dinner
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors released a video showing a man armed with guns and knives attempting to storm the White House Correspondents' Association dinner. The incident allegedly involved an attempt to kill US President Donald Trump. The video, released on Thursday, captures the moment the armed individual tried to gain access to the event. The man, identified as Cole Allen, has been accused of trying to kill the President at the correspondents' gala. Allen has agreed to remain jailed. The video release is part of the ongoing case against Allen, who is accused of attempting to harm the President during the high-profile event. The incident highlights concerns about security and potential threats to public figures, including the President.

stories.headline: ‘Anger and frustration’: Australian PM speaks on Kumanjayi Little Baby
stories.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has called for calm in Alice Springs after the body of Kumanjayi Little Baby was found, sparking riots and outrage in the community. Albanese acknowledged the "anger and frustration" felt by many, but urged residents to "come together." Senior Aboriginal elder Robin Granites, a spokesperson for the family, also appealed for restraint. The community had been demanding justice and accusing police of protecting the alleged attacker, with some calling for "payback." The Prime Minister's plea for calm comes after a night of disorder in Alice Springs, with many expressing grief and anger over the young boy's death. Albanese described the news of Kumanjayi Little Baby's death as "heartbreaking," and encouraged the community to unite during this difficult time.

stories.headline: JPMorgan Executive Lorna Hajdini Denies 'Sex Slave' Claims, Calls Allegations "Fabricated"
stories.summary: JPMorgan executive Lorna Hajdini has denied allegations of coercing a former junior banker into non-consensual sex acts, calling the claims "fabricated". The allegations were made in a lawsuit filed by 35-year-old Chirayu Rana, who claimed Hajdini drugged him and threatened his career with racial slurs. Hajdini's lawyers stated that she "categorically denies the allegations" and has never engaged in any inappropriate conduct. The lawsuit also alleged that Hajdini turned Rana into her "sex slave" for months, but Hajdini claims she has never even visited the location where the alleged incidents took place. JPMorgan has also denied the allegations, calling them a fabrication. The lawsuit has been retracted, with Hajdini and the bank maintaining that the claims are entirely false.

stories.headline: AI And Competitive Advantage Need More Than Mandates Studies show that generative AI homogenizes ideas across teams. Companies that bet on usage quotas alone risk eroding the differentiation that sets them apart.
stories.summary: Studies have found that generative AI can homogenize ideas across teams, potentially eroding a company's differentiation. Mandating AI use without creative guardrails can work against a company's competitive advantage. While AI can boost individual output, it can also lead to similar ideas being produced by different teams. Research suggests that AI is unlikely to create a competitive advantage on its own, but can reinforce existing strengths such as operational excellence or customer intimacy. Companies that rely solely on AI usage quotas risk losing their unique edge. Instead, AI can be used to widen and deepen existing moats, making them harder to cross. Context is becoming a key competitive advantage as companies increasingly use the same AI models, highlighting the need for strategic integration of AI to maintain differentiation.

stories.headline: Instagram Extends Crack Down on Unoriginal Content to Photos, Carousel Posts Meta's Instagram is now cracking down on the upload of the unoriginal content in photos and carousel posts.
stories.summary: Instagram is expanding its crackdown on unoriginal content to include photos and carousel posts. The platform will now penalize accounts that reshare these types of content without making "material" edits. This means that accounts primarily posting unoriginal content may see their reach reduced. The change aims to ensure original creators receive credit and distribution for their work. Previously, these protections were in place for Reels, and are now being applied to photos and carousel posts. Content aggregators can still reupload posts, but must make meaningful transformations to avoid penalties. Instagram's goal is to promote original content and give creators the recognition they deserve. The updated guidelines are part of Meta's efforts to maintain a platform that values and rewards originality and creativity.

stories.headline: vivo Y11d now official vivo has officially launched the vivo Y11d in the Philippines, an entry-level device. The phone sports a 6.74” LCD display...
stories.summary: Vivo has officially launched the vivo Y11d in the Philippines, an entry-level device. The phone features a 6.74-inch LCD display with a 1600 × 720 resolution and up to a 120Hz refresh rate, reaching up to 1,200 nits of brightness. The device is equipped with an 8MP rear camera and a 5MP front camera. It is powered by the Unisoc T7225 chipset and runs on Android 16 with OriginOS 6. Initially released in Bangladesh on March 12, 2026, the vivo Y11d is targeted at consumers who value long battery life and daily operations. The phone's specifications and features position it as a low-cost smartphone option for entry-level users in the Philippines and Bangladesh.

stories.headline: May 2026’s PlayStation Plus Essential Games Have Been Revealed Difficulty is the theme for May
stories.summary: PlayStation has revealed the free games for PS Plus subscribers at the Essential tier for May 2026. The three games available for free starting May 5 are EA Sports FC 26, Wuchang: Fallen Feathers, and Nine Sols. These games will be accessible to all PS Plus members, offering a challenging experience. The theme for May's selection is difficulty, catering to players who enjoy a challenge. The announcement comes ahead of the games' availability on May 5, allowing subscribers to prepare for the new additions to their gaming library. Additionally, Limited Run Games has announced a separate release, Rugrats: Retro Rewind, a collection of six Rugrats games, also launching in May.

stories.headline: Knicks’ 47-point halftime lead vs. Hawks sets record for largest in NBA playoff history As expected with such a lopsided score, emotions ran high, and two players were ejected in the second quarter.
stories.summary: The New York Knicks set an NBA playoff record with a 47-point halftime lead over the Atlanta Hawks in Game 6 of their Eastern Conference first-round series. The Knicks led 83-36 at halftime, surpassing the previous record of 41 points. The team was led by strong defense and OG Anunoby's 26 points. The game was marked by high emotions, with two players ejected in the second quarter. The Knicks' dominant performance resulted in a final score of 140-89, securing a historic blowout win. The 47-point halftime lead is the largest in NBA playoff history, besting the previous record that had been achieved twice before. The Knicks' impressive win was a decisive conclusion to the game, with the team's smothering defense and strong offense proving too much for the Hawks to overcome.

stories.headline: Hawks' Daniels, Knicks' Robinson ejected for fighting Atlanta's Dyson Daniels and New York's Mitchell Robinson were ejected from Game 6 of the Hawks-Knicks playoff series Thursday night after a fight that prompted
stories.summary: Atlanta Hawks' Dyson Daniels and New York Knicks' Mitchell Robinson were ejected from Game 6 of their playoff series after a fight. The altercation led to offsetting technical fouls and occurred during a game in which the Knicks dominated the Hawks. The Knicks had a strong start, scoring 40-15 in the first quarter and extending their lead to 55-10 at one point. The fight broke out partway through the game, resulting in the ejections of Daniels and Robinson. The Hawks ultimately faced a significant deficit, with the Knicks' lead being one of the largest in the series. The incident marked a turning point in the game, with the Knicks maintaining their lead after the ejections. The game was part of the Hawks-Knicks playoff series, with the Knicks seeking to advance.

stories.headline: Philadelphia forces Game 7 against Boston behind 30 points from Tyrese Maxey For two games in a row, the 76ers perimeter defense has given the Celtics trouble.
stories.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers forced a Game 7 against the Boston Celtics with a 106-93 victory. Tyrese Maxey led the team with 30 points, including 21 in the first half, making all three of his three-point attempts. Paul George contributed 23 points to the 76ers' dominant performance. The Celtics never led in Game 6, with Jaylen Brown hampered by three fouls in the first half and finishing with 18 points. Maxey's strong first half set the tone for the game, forcing Boston to close out hard and allowing him to drive and score on the interior. The 76ers' perimeter defense has given the Celtics trouble for two consecutive games, setting up a decisive Game 7. The win ensures the series will go the full distance, with the final game to determine the outcome.

stories.headline: R Ashwin Puts End To IPL Catch Row Which Left Virat Kohli Fuming With "RCB Fan" Angle The IPL 2026 match between Gujarat Titans and Royal Challengers Bengaluru witnessed a major controversy over Jason Holder's catch to dismiss Rajat Patidar.
stories.summary: The IPL 2026 match between Gujarat Titans and Royal Challengers Bengaluru was marred by controversy over a catch by Jason Holder to dismiss Rajat Patidar. The incident left Royal Challengers Bengaluru captain Virat Kohli fuming. However, former Indian spinner Ravichandran Ashwin intervened, putting an end to the row by introducing an "RCB fan" angle. Ashwin, who has played 16 seasons in the IPL for five different teams, recently announced the end of his IPL career. The match ultimately saw Gujarat Titans emerge victorious, winning by four wickets. Captain Shubman Gill expressed satisfaction with the win. The controversy surrounding the catch had sparked debate, but Ashwin's intervention helped to diffuse the situation, bringing a close to the incident. The IPL 2026 season continues, with teams competing for the top spot.

stories.headline: Woman found clutching son, 4, in Jabalpur boat tragedy; minister breaks down
stories.summary: A woman and her 4-year-old son were found dead, embracing each other, after a boat capsized near Bargi Dam in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. The two were recovered with life jackets still on them, tied to the same life jacket. The incident has left family members and state officials distraught, with Cabinet Minister Rakesh Singh breaking down upon visiting the site. The boat accident has resulted in at least 9 deaths, with several people still missing. Rescue efforts are ongoing, and the state's Tourism Minister has ordered a probe into the incident. The tragic discovery of the mother and son has added to the shock and grief of the community, with many struggling to come to terms with the loss of life. The investigation into the cause of the accident is currently underway.

stories.headline: Watch: Terrifying moment as cruise boat flips over at Jabalpur dam mid-ride; 9 dead
stories.summary: A cruise boat capsized at Jabalpur's Bargi Dam in Madhya Pradesh, resulting in the deaths of at least 9 people, with 6 still missing. The incident occurred during a sudden storm, causing the boat to lose balance and overturn in the turbulent waters of the Narmada River. A video captured the terrifying moment the boat flipped over mid-ride. The boat, operated by Madhya Pradesh Tourism, was carrying passengers when the tragedy struck. Reports indicate that warnings were ignored and life jackets were not worn, contributing to the high number of casualties. Rescue efforts are ongoing, with dozens of people rescued so far. The death toll is expected to rise as search operations continue to locate the missing individuals.

stories.headline: Mother of 2 dies after ‘digital arrest’ blackmail, video calls by fake cop during funeral reveal scam
stories.summary: A 28-year-old woman from Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh, allegedly died by suicide after being harassed by cyber fraudsters posing as Crime Branch officers. The woman, a mother of two, left behind a suicide note blaming a blackmailer. Her family found multiple threatening WhatsApp calls and messages from the scammers. The fraudsters claimed a parcel with her name was being sent from Mumbai to Iran, containing passports, debit cards, laptops, US dollars, and narcotics. They used this false information to blackmail her, leading to her death. During her funeral, the family received video calls from a person claiming to be a police officer, further revealing the scam. The incident highlights the growing concern of cyber fraud and its devastating consequences. The police are investigating the matter.

stories.headline: Govt notifies changes to Citizenship Rules; focus on OCI registration
stories.summary: The Indian government has notified changes to the Citizenship Rules, 2026, with a focus on revamping the Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) registration system. The updated rules introduce a fully digitized OCI registration process, with digital applications and streamlined procedures for cardholders. The changes aim to enhance the OCI application process while strengthening compliance and security provisions. A key amendment is the mandatory shift to an online-only system for OCI applications. The new rules, called the Citizenship (Amendment) Rules, 2026, will come into effect upon publication in the Official Gazette. The digitization of the OCI registration system is expected to improve efficiency and reduce processing times for applicants. The updated rules also reinforce security-related provisions under the citizenship framework, ensuring a more secure and streamlined process for OCI cardholders. The changes are part of the government's efforts to modernize its citizenship regulations.

stories.headline: Eurovision: 70 years of geopolitics, patriotism, music and glitter VIENNA — It has been the crucible of music icons from ABBA to Celine Dion, a flashy symbol of European integration, the charged focal point for geopolitics
stories.summary: The Eurovision Song Contest is celebrating its 70th anniversary, with the 2026 edition taking place in Vienna, Austria. The contest has been a platform for launching music icons such as ABBA and Celine Dion. Over the years, it has also been a symbol of European integration, a focal point for geopolitics, and a stage for social change. The world's largest music competition will feature a spectacular backdrop in Vienna, a city known for its musical brilliance, from Mozart to modern pop. The 2026 contest will mark a significant milestone in the history of the Eurovision Song Contest, which has been a popular event for seven decades. The event is expected to showcase a mix of music, patriotism, and glitter, with participants from various European countries competing for the top prize. Vienna's hosting of the event is set to be a grand celebration of music and culture.

stories.headline: The Changing Landscape of West Asian Defence and Security Asad Mirza The old framework of rigid alliances in West Asia is giving way to overlapping security partnerships, strategic hedging, internal military modernizat
stories.summary: West Asia's defence and security landscape is undergoing a significant transformation, shifting away from rigid alliances. The region is now characterized by overlapping security partnerships, strategic hedging, and internal military modernization. New calculations are being shaped by technology, economics, and traditional geopolitics, leading to a more complex and dynamic security architecture. This transformation is one of the most profound in decades, marking a significant change in the region's defence and security framework. The old alliances are giving way to more flexible and adaptive partnerships, driven by emerging technologies and economic interests, as well as traditional geopolitical considerations. This shift reflects the evolving nature of security threats and the need for West Asian countries to navigate multiple interests and alliances.

stories.headline: Pahalgam Aftershock: Terror’s Persistence And India’s Strategic Test The Pahalgam attack is being seen as a reminder of persistent terrorism threats and the need for India to strengthen deterrence, intelligence and diplomacy
stories.summary: A terrorist attack in Pahalgam, Jammu and Kashmir, has heightened tensions between India and Pakistan. The attack is seen as a reminder of persistent terrorism threats, with Pakistan-backed networks posing a wider challenge. Indian Prime Minister Modi vowed to take decisive action against those responsible, pledging to "identify, track, and punish" the perpetrators. Pakistan responded with a warning that any threat to its sovereignty would be met with "firm reciprocal measures." The Indian Army, along with Central Armed Police forces and J&K Police, is conducting cordon and search operations to nab the four terrorists, including two from Pakistan. The US is walking a diplomatic tightrope, trying to avoid being seen as favouring one side over the other. India has announced punitive actions against Pakistan, prompting Islamabad to hold a meeting in response.

stories.headline: Stocks up after mixed mega cap earnings and geopolitics - Newsquawk US Market Wrap ZeroHedge - On a long enough timeline, the survival rate for everyone drops to zero
stories.summary: US stocks ended the day mixed, with the Nasdaq outperforming, ahead of key earnings reports. Notable gains were seen in heavyweight stocks, excluding Tesla, while Broadcom rallied on reports of developing an AI inference chip with OpenAI. The year-over-year rate rose to 3.5%, in line with expectations, driven largely by higher energy prices. The hiring rate remains depressed, unlikely to accelerate in the near term, especially considering the US/Iran conflict. US equity futures strengthened after NVIDIA's earnings report, and crude prices increased following the Kremlin's statement that it will not engage in peace talks with the US. The mixed earnings reports and geopolitical developments have contributed to the market's volatility, with investors closely watching the situation unfold. Key earnings reports and economic data will continue to influence market trends in the coming days.

stories.headline: Farooq Abdullah Claims Lack Of Support Within INDIA Bloc On Restoration Of J&K Statehood
stories.summary: National Conference president Farooq Abdullah expressed disappointment over the INDIA bloc's lack of support for restoring Jammu and Kashmir's statehood. He specifically mentioned the Congress party's insufficient backing, despite his expectations. Abdullah reaffirmed his commitment to peacefully restoring J&K's constitutional rights. The INDIA bloc, including Congress, had planned to raise the issue on July 19. Congress also announced protests in Srinagar, Jammu, and Delhi to push for statehood restoration. Abdullah had earlier backed a Congress letter to the Prime Minister seeking J&K statehood. The issue of statehood restoration has been a key concern for the people of Jammu and Kashmir, and Abdullah's comments highlight the perceived lack of urgency from the INDIA bloc in addressing this issue. The protests and planned discussions aim to bring attention to the matter.

stories.headline: Biden Administration Unveils New Immigration Policy Amid Border Crisis
stories.summary: The Biden Administration has introduced a new immigration policy amid the ongoing border crisis. Border crossings have significantly decreased, with 47,330 migrant apprehensions recorded in December 2024, down from nearly 250,000 in December 2023. The administration's comprehensive immigration reform proposal, the U.S. Citizenship Act of 2021, was introduced in the House and Senate. The proposal aims to address the border crisis and immigration issues. Critics argue that the administration's refusal to enforce immigration laws and finish the border wall has led to an increase in illegal fentanyl and human trafficking. The new policy comes as the administration seeks to address these concerns and reform the immigration system. The decrease in border crossings suggests that the administration's efforts may be yielding results, with a notable drop in migrant apprehensions over the past year.

stories.headline: US Senate Votes to Approve $1.5 Trillion Spending Bill to Avoid Government Shutdown
stories.summary: The US Senate voted to approve a $1.5 trillion spending bill, avoiding a government shutdown. The bill's passage came after Senator Joe Manchin III expressed opposition to a social safety net bill exceeding $1.5 trillion, less than half of President Biden's proposed package. A temporary funding bill was previously passed by the House, but it stalled in the Senate. To avoid a shutdown, a supermajority of Senate votes was required, giving Democrats leverage. Senate Majority Leader Schumer ultimately voted for the short-term spending bill, despite calling it "very bad," citing the worse consequences of a shutdown. The bill's approval ensures the continuation of government services and avoids the furlough of thousands of federal employees. President Biden signed a continuing resolution bill to avoid a shutdown, and the new spending bill will now be sent to him for signature.

stories.headline: European Union Leaders Gather for Emergency Summit to Discuss Rising Tensions with Russia
stories.summary: European Union leaders have gathered for an emergency summit to discuss rising tensions with Russia and the ongoing crisis in Ukraine. The meeting comes amid concerns over waning US support and growing pressure to increase defense spending. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has proposed a plan to loosen budget rules, allowing countries to spend more on defense, backed by 150 billion euros in loans for priority military equipment. The summit also addresses the Iran crisis and a potential mutual assistance pact, as EU leaders seek to reassure each other of their commitment to collective defense. The meeting follows a pre-summit gathering of liberal EU leaders, including French President Emmanuel Macron and others, who discussed the Ukraine situation and NATO doubts. The EU is seeking to strengthen its defense capabilities and present a united front amid growing tensions with Russia.

stories.headline: NSE, BSE closed today: Next stock market holiday in May 2026 after Maharashtra Day
stories.summary: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) are closed today, May 1, 2026, in observance of Maharashtra Day. This closure affects equity, derivatives, currency derivatives, SLB, and EGR segments. Following this holiday, the next stock market holiday is scheduled for May 28, 2026, to celebrate Bakri Id (Eid-ul-Adha). Although equity markets are closed, commodity markets will operate partially today, with trading available in the evening. There are a total of 16 stock market holidays planned for 2026, according to official exchange data. The current closure and upcoming holiday on May 28 will result in a shortened trading week for Indian markets.

stories.headline: Stock Market Holiday Today: BSE, NSE Shut For Maharashtra Day; MCX To Open At 5 PM For Evening Session
stories.summary: The Indian stock market is closed for trading on Friday, May 1, due to Maharashtra Day. Both the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE) are shut, with trading suspended across equity, derivatives, and currency segments. The Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX) is closed for the morning session but will open at 5 PM for the evening session. The National Commodity and Derivatives Exchange (NCDEX) remains closed for the day. The holiday is observed to commemorate the formation of the state of Maharashtra. As a result, investors will not be able to trade on the BSE and NSE today, while MCX will have a limited trading session in the evening. All trading activities will resume on the next working day.

stories.headline: Most major stock markets across Asia are also closed today, May 1, on account of Labour Day
stories.summary: Major stock markets in Asia are closed on May 1 due to Labour Day. The holiday is typically celebrated with outdoor activities such as barbecues, picnics, and parades. The closure provides a break for investors from the busy earnings season. Benchmark indices, such as the Sensex and Nifty, have experienced significant fluctuations in recent months, largely influenced by global news, particularly from the United States. The stock market closure affects trading and market activities, with investors awaiting the resumption of trading. The Labour Day holiday is observed in many countries, resulting in a pause in stock market activities across Asia. Investors can expect trading to resume after the holiday, with market movements likely to be influenced by global economic trends and news. The closure is a scheduled holiday, allowing investors a brief pause from market activities.

stories.headline: BSE Sensex edging up 0.3% and the NSE
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty ended the week on a positive note, with gains of 0.3% and 0.4%, respectively. On Wednesday, the S&P BSE Sensex rose 363.81 points to 77,250.72, while the NSE Nifty50 gained 119.70 points to 24,115.40. However, on Thursday, the indices opened in red, with the Nifty50 dropping below 24,000 and the BSE Sensex falling below 77,000, losing over 600 points. This decline was attributed to crude oil prices surpassing $120 per barrel, nearing 2022 highs. The UAE's announcement to exit the OPEC group also impacted the market. Despite a holiday-shortened schedule, the benchmarks managed to close the week with mild gains, with the Sensex and Nifty showing volatility amidst global market developments. The Indian stock markets experienced significant fluctuations during the week.

stories.headline: UK high street giant falls into administration owing £40m
stories.summary: UK high street giant Quiz has fallen into administration, owing approximately £40 million to creditors. The company's collapse has resulted in over 100 redundancies, with administrators Interpath assessing the viability of its 40 remaining stores. If no buyer is found by the end of April, these stores may also close. Quiz's gift card holders are owed £1.3 million, while other connected companies and creditors are owed the remainder. The statement of affairs indicates that creditors will receive only a fraction of the amount owed. This collapse is the latest in a series of high street failures, including Wilko and Jamie Oliver's restaurant chain, which have struggled to stay afloat amidst a decline in casual dining and high street sales. Administrators will now work to determine the best course of action for Quiz's remaining assets.

stories.headline: Paramount Sued by Subscribers Seeking to Block Warner Bros. Deal
stories.summary: A group of Paramount+ subscribers filed a lawsuit in the US District Court for the Northern District of California, seeking to block the $110 billion merger between Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. The plaintiffs, three current Paramount+ subscribers, allege the deal will harm competition in the premium video distribution market, lower the quality of national TV news, and lead to fewer theatrical films. They also claim the combined company would have increased ability to drive up prices and damage journalism. The lawsuit argues that the proposed merger would have negative consequences for consumers, and the plaintiffs are urging a federal judge to block the deal. The merger, valued at $110 billion, has raised concerns about its potential impact on the media industry and consumers.

stories.headline: TEPCO Swings into Annual Net Loss
stories.summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings Inc. reported a net loss of 454.2 billion yen for the fiscal year ended in March, compared to a profit of 161.2 billion yen the previous year. The loss was primarily due to over 900 billion yen in charges related to the decommissioning of the Fukushima No. 1 nuclear plant. Despite increased operating and ordinary income, net sales declined, and the company's equity ratio was reduced. No dividend was paid, and guidance for the next fiscal year was withheld due to uncertainty over fuel prices. The net loss attributable to owners of the parent company was 662.7 billion yen, resulting in a decline in net assets. The significant loss is a result of the ongoing costs associated with the decommissioning of the disaster-stricken nuclear plant.

stories.headline: JPMorgan Executive Lorna Hajdini Denies 'Sex Slave' Claims, Calls Allegations "Fabricated"
stories.summary: JPMorgan executive Lorna Hajdini has denied allegations of sexual harassment, coercion, and racial abuse made by a former junior employee, Chirayu Rana, in a New York lawsuit. The lawsuit claims Hajdini engaged in sexual coercion and abuse, which she vehemently denies, calling the allegations "fabricated". JPMorgan Chase has also stated that an internal investigation found no merit to the claims, citing a lack of cooperation from the complainant. The bank denies any wrongdoing, and Hajdini has strongly denied the allegations, including claims of being a "sex slave" master. The lawsuit is ongoing, with JPMorgan and Hajdini maintaining that the allegations are unfounded and lack evidence. The internal investigation's findings support Hajdini's and the bank's position, but the lawsuit's outcome is still pending.

stories.headline: OpenAI’s Missed Targets Rattle Investors
stories.summary: OpenAI has missed its internal revenue and user growth targets, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The company's CFO, Sarah Friar, expressed concerns about its ability to fulfill future compute contracts if revenue doesn't improve. The report stated that OpenAI's missed targets have raised concerns among company leaders about supporting its massive spending on data centers. The news sent some tech stocks into decline on Tuesday, putting market pressure on the entire sector. However, investors in private AI labs remain unfazed. OpenAI has dismissed the report as "clickbait." The missed targets have sparked concerns about the company's financial stability and its ability to fund future computing contracts, which are crucial for its operations. The development has significant implications for the tech industry and OpenAI's future growth prospects.

stories.headline: The lawsuit alleges that under Altman's leadership, OpenAI, the nonprofit San Francisco artificial intelligence developer, has abandoned its charitable mission
stories.summary: Elon Musk has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, alleging that the nonprofit artificial intelligence developer has abandoned its charitable mission under Altman's leadership. The lawsuit claims that OpenAI has transformed into a primarily profit-focused commercial enterprise, violating the law governing nonprofits. Musk alleges breach of charitable trust and unjust enrichment, seeking to remove Altman and other leaders, revert OpenAI to nonprofit status, and secure damages. OpenAI has countered that its shift was not due to a change in nonprofit status, but rather Musk's desire for control. The lawsuit highlights a clash between control and profit, with Musk seeking to restore OpenAI's original nonprofit purpose. The case is ongoing, with OpenAI pushing back against Musk's allegations in court filings. The outcome could impact the future of OpenAI and its operations.

stories.headline: On witness stand, Elon Musk accuses Sam Altman's lawyer of trying to trick him
stories.summary: Elon Musk testified in a trial against OpenAI, accusing a lawyer for the company of trying to trick him during cross-examination. The trial, which began four days ago, centers on a lawsuit filed by Musk in 2024, alleging that OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman, and others, including Microsoft, betrayed the company's original non-profit mission. Musk took the stand, initially answering questions from his lawyer, Steven Molo, about his career, but was repeatedly admonished by Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers for leading the witness. The case may determine the future of OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT. Musk's lawsuit claims that Altman and others shifted the company's focus to a for-profit structure, violating its founding vision. The trial continues, with Musk and Altman's testimonies expected to be crucial in resolving the dispute.

stories.headline: Judge warns lawyers that AI itself is not on trial
stories.summary: In the Musk v. Altman case, a judge warned lawyers that AI itself is not on trial. During Elon Musk's testimony against OpenAI, the judge intervened as tensions rose between both sides. The judge cautioned that lawyers could face prosecution for presenting material generated by AI tools that is inaccurate or "hallucinated." The court was unable to verify several cited cases, highlighting concerns about the use of AI in legal proceedings. This issue comes after the American Bar Association issued an ethics opinion on lawyers' responsibilities when using generative AI. The judge's warning emphasizes the need for accuracy and reliability in legal evidence, amidst growing concerns about AI's role in the courtroom. The trial continues, with the judge closely monitoring the use of AI-generated material.
